title: Suns still on top, Knicks on the rise
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 8
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Considering the travel hell they endured just to make it to their first loss in five weeks and the show they put on in defeat, Suns deserve to stay at No. 1. Don't they?
rankings.summaryText: Considering the travel hell they endured just to make it to their first loss in five weeks and the show they put on in defeat, Suns deserve to stay at No. 1. Don't they?

rankings.summaryHtml: Dirk's latest ankle scare looked bad on TV, but Mavs weren't too worried. Besides that outside game for the ages, our favorite 7-footer is also blessed with bionic ankles.
rankings.summaryText: Dirk's latest ankle scare looked bad on TV, but Mavs weren't too worried. Besides that outside game for the ages, our favorite 7-footer is also blessed with bionic ankles.

rankings.summaryHtml: Cruising? Spurs snoozed in a home loss to McGrady-less Houston and lost their only two games this month against teams with winning records as of Christmas morning.
rankings.summaryText: Cruising? Spurs snoozed in a home loss to McGrady-less Houston and lost their only two games this month against teams with winning records as of Christmas morning.

rankings.summaryHtml: This December (7-3) isn't as good as last December (13-2), but Pistons will begin 2007 as the East's current beast, with a still-stingy D and a developing bench.
rankings.summaryText: This December (7-3) isn't as good as last December (13-2), but Pistons will begin 2007 as the East's current beast, with a still-stingy D and a developing bench.

rankings.summaryHtml: Dare we say Melo's suspension did not clinch Utah's Northwest title by Christmas. Not with Jazz just 8-7 since their 12-1 start and eight of their next 13 on the road.
rankings.summaryText: Dare we say Melo's suspension did not clinch Utah's Northwest title by Christmas. Not with Jazz just 8-7 since their 12-1 start and eight of their next 13 on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: You were wrong if you figured Lakers would fold or Kobe would just fire away with Odom out. L.A. is 4-3 sans Lamar and Bryant has averaged 7.8 apg over the last five.
rankings.summaryText: You were wrong if you figured Lakers would fold or Kobe would just fire away with Odom out. L.A. is 4-3 sans Lamar and Bryant has averaged 7.8 apg over the last five.

rankings.summaryHtml: Go ahead, use 'em all: Agent Zero, Captain Quirk, World's Greatest Arenas. Ring up 60 and 54 in a six-day span, as Gil did, and one nickname isn't enough.
rankings.summaryText: Go ahead, use 'em all: Agent Zero, Captain Quirk, World's Greatest Arenas. Ring up 60 and 54 in a six-day span, as Gil did, and one nickname isn't enough.

rankings.summaryHtml: A cushy schedule accelerated Bulls' 13-2 run, but Gordon's move to the bench hasn't hurt. Back as sixth man for 21 games, Gordon has led the team in scoring 10 times.
rankings.summaryText: A cushy schedule accelerated Bulls' 13-2 run, but Gordon's move to the bench hasn't hurt. Back as sixth man for 21 games, Gordon has led the team in scoring 10 times.

rankings.summaryHtml: Rockets spank Spurs without T-Mac, helped big by Bonzi, only for Yao to go down one night later. Didn't have the heart to drop 'em, but it'll soon be unavoidable.
rankings.summaryText: Rockets spank Spurs without T-Mac, helped big by Bonzi, only for Yao to go down one night later. Didn't have the heart to drop 'em, but it'll soon be unavoidable.

rankings.summaryHtml: Maybe it wasn't the rise to No. 3 that messed up Magic. Maybe the real problem is the name change to Amway Arena: Orlando is 3-6 since that was announced.
rankings.summaryText: Maybe it wasn't the rise to No. 3 that messed up Magic. Maybe the real problem is the name change to Amway Arena: Orlando is 3-6 since that was announced.

rankings.summaryHtml: Distressing as it was to score 71 points in Saturday's Conseco loss to Wolves, Pacers are still No. 2 in the East in plus/minus: 7 road wins and 4 home defeats = +3.
rankings.summaryText: Distressing as it was to score 71 points in Saturday's Conseco loss to Wolves, Pacers are still No. 2 in the East in plus/minus: 7 road wins and 4 home defeats = +3.

rankings.summaryHtml: Wins in Boston and Orlando addressed Warriors' road woes, but their injury problem is only spreading, claiming Ellis, Murphy and Pietrus as its latest victims.
rankings.summaryText: Wins in Boston and Orlando addressed Warriors' road woes, but their injury problem is only spreading, claiming Ellis, Murphy and Pietrus as its latest victims.

rankings.summaryHtml: With Camby freshly injured and Melo and J.R. suspended, Iverson will hear Sixers West cracks about his new team. But it's still quite a trade coup for Denver.
rankings.summaryText: With Camby freshly injured and Melo and J.R. suspended, Iverson will hear Sixers West cracks about his new team. But it's still quite a trade coup for Denver.

rankings.summaryHtml: Cavs always say they play better against tougher competition. With 11 of the next 14 on the road, seven of those in the West, this would seem an ideal time to prove it.
rankings.summaryText: Cavs always say they play better against tougher competition. With 11 of the next 14 on the road, seven of those in the West, this would seem an ideal time to prove it.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's a jolly Christmas, indeed, in the PDX. Blazers have quietly posted a 6-5 record this month -- including a 4-2 road trip -- and just activated Roy (for ROY).
rankings.summaryText: It's a jolly Christmas, indeed, in the PDX. Blazers have quietly posted a 6-5 record this month -- including a 4-2 road trip -- and just activated Roy (for ROY).

rankings.summaryHtml: Shaq-less Heat are 8-9 since Prof. Hollinger proclaimed them a candidate to plummet all the way into the lottery ... but just a half-game out of a playoff spot.
rankings.summaryText: Shaq-less Heat are 8-9 since Prof. Hollinger proclaimed them a candidate to plummet all the way into the lottery ... but just a half-game out of a playoff spot.

rankings.summaryHtml: With Redd getting scoring help from Mo Williams and Bucks winning six straight at home, Central is finally starting to live up to its top-to-bottom reputation for quality.
rankings.summaryText: With Redd getting scoring help from Mo Williams and Bucks winning six straight at home, Central is finally starting to live up to its top-to-bottom reputation for quality.

rankings.summaryHtml: Some trivia to take KG's mind off missing out on A.I.: Did you know Wolves are one of only four teams (with Grizz, Hornets, Bobcats) never to play on Christmas Day?
rankings.summaryText: Some trivia to take KG's mind off missing out on A.I.: Did you know Wolves are one of only four teams (with Grizz, Hornets, Bobcats) never to play on Christmas Day?

rankings.summaryHtml: Didn't expect Clips to go after Artest again so soon. But it's not so shocking when their defense, an oft-overlooked key last season, has dropped off so drastically.
rankings.summaryText: Didn't expect Clips to go after Artest again so soon. But it's not so shocking when their defense, an oft-overlooked key last season, has dropped off so drastically.

rankings.summaryHtml: With Nets in chaos, Pierce ailing in Boston and a helpful second-half sked, Raps have a real shot to stay right where they are. Especially after going 5-4 without Bosh.
rankings.summaryText: With Nets in chaos, Pierce ailing in Boston and a helpful second-half sked, Raps have a real shot to stay right where they are. Especially after going 5-4 without Bosh.

rankings.summaryHtml: Artest insists that all the negative whispers in Sac are ''just false reports.'' The problem? Bibby's increasing silence and ongoing struggles suggest otherwise.
rankings.summaryText: Artest insists that all the negative whispers in Sac are ''just false reports.'' The problem? Bibby's increasing silence and ongoing struggles suggest otherwise.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's not so easy to celebrate Ray's return -- even though it halted a six-game losing streak -- when Rashard goes down for eight weeks just before Allen gets activated.
rankings.summaryText: It's not so easy to celebrate Ray's return -- even though it halted a six-game losing streak -- when Rashard goes down for eight weeks just before Allen gets activated.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's not much consolation, but at least Peja, D-West and Hornets aren't alone in their injury misery. Rockets (Yao and T-Mac) can claim to be even more miserable.
rankings.summaryText: It's not much consolation, but at least Peja, D-West and Hornets aren't alone in their injury misery. Rockets (Yao and T-Mac) can claim to be even more miserable.

rankings.summaryHtml: Look at it this way: At least Pierce is missing a stretch that probably wasn't filled with wins anyway, with Celts going West for the first five games after Christmas.
rankings.summaryText: Look at it this way: At least Pierce is missing a stretch that probably wasn't filled with wins anyway, with Celts going West for the first five games after Christmas.

rankings.summaryHtml: Overcoming their seemingly annual slow start is no lock now, with Krstic lost for the season and Jefferson ailing, too. So you have to ask: time to shop Vince/start over?
rankings.summaryText: Overcoming their seemingly annual slow start is no lock now, with Krstic lost for the season and Jefferson ailing, too. So you have to ask: time to shop Vince/start over?

rankings.summaryHtml: Can't promise they'll win 30 games -- even if D. Lee continues to be a rebound machine -- but we do know this: Knicks are the first team this season to play 30.
rankings.summaryText: Can't promise they'll win 30 games -- even if D. Lee continues to be a rebound machine -- but we do know this: Knicks are the first team this season to play 30.

rankings.summaryHtml: With the sale unraveling and Grizz sliding to 2-11 this month, it was rather easy to miss Pau's 28 points, nine boards and three blocks in an OT loss to Hornets.
rankings.summaryText: With the sale unraveling and Grizz sliding to 2-11 this month, it was rather easy to miss Pau's 28 points, nine boards and three blocks in an OT loss to Hornets.

rankings.summaryHtml: Hawks, I'm quite sure, will regret their predictable reluctance to bid for Iverson. Thanks to a 1-8 skid and with injuries galore, their annual nosedive is in full flight.
rankings.summaryText: Hawks, I'm quite sure, will regret their predictable reluctance to bid for Iverson. Thanks to a 1-8 skid and with injuries galore, their annual nosedive is in full flight.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bobs, as promised, beat Utah to claim their fifth W this season against a division leader. Too bad Tuesday's foes in Dallas are a half-game out of Southwest lead.
rankings.summaryText: Bobs, as promised, beat Utah to claim their fifth W this season against a division leader. Too bad Tuesday's foes in Dallas are a half-game out of Southwest lead.

rankings.summaryHtml: Two wins in a row after two W's in (gulp) 44 days. But we repeat our Weekend Dime warning: Miller, Smith could make Sixers just decent enough to hurt their Oden odds.
